data.proposedYaml:
roles:
  a:
    permission_model_version: 2
    allow:
      connections:
        - uat-mysql
      tableSelectors:
        - connection: uat-mysql
          schema: uat
          names:
            - uat_begin_zero_orders
          row_access: all
      tools:
        - lucy_catalog
        - lucy_query
        - lucy_read_source
        - lucy_explain_query
        - lucy_begin_question
        - lucy_continue_question
        - connection_list
  b:
    permission_model_version: 2
    allow:
      connections:
        - uat-mysql
      tableSelectors:
        - connection: uat-mysql
          schema: uat
          names:
            - uat_begin_zero_orders
          row_access: scoped
          row_policy:
            predicates:
              - field: tenant
                op: eq
                value: NORTH
      tools:
        - lucy_catalog
        - lucy_query
        - lucy_read_source
        - lucy_explain_query
        - lucy_begin_question
        - lucy_continue_question
        - connection_list
  c:
    permission_model_version: 2
    allow:
      connections:
        - uat-mysql
      tableSelectors:
        - connection: uat-mysql
          schema: uat
          names:
            - uat_begin_zero_orders
          row_access: all
      tools:
        - lucy_catalog
        - lucy_query
        - lucy_read_source
        - lucy_explain_query
        - lucy_continue_question
        - connection_list
users:
  - id: uat_zb_a
    name: ZB a
    enabled: true
    role: a
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-a
        created: 2026-11-20
  - id: uat_zb_b
    name: ZB b
    enabled: true
    role: b
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-b
        created: 2026-11-20
  - id: uat_zb_c
    name: ZB c
    enabled: true
    role: c
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-c
        created: 2026-11-20
  - id: uat_zb_expired
    name: ZB expired
    enabled: true
    role: a
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-expired
        created: 2026-11-20
        expires_at: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z
  - id: uat_zb_disabled
    name: ZB disabled
    enabled: true
    role: a
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-disabled
        created: 2026-11-20
  - id: uat_zb_denied
    name: ZB denied
    enabled: true
    role: a
    tokens:
      - hash: [REDACTED]
        label: isolated-denied
        created: 2026-11-20
    note: isolated UAT control r09-fault-activate

    - sql_execution
